---
title: "NY NOAA Weather Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
```

```{r data}
data("ny_noaa")

weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
    date < as.Date("2011-01-01")
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Average Maximum Temperature

```{r}
temp_df =
  weather_df |>
  mutate(month = lubridate::month(date)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  temp_df,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~avg_tmax,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### Distribution of Maximum Temperature

```{r}
plot_ly(
  weather_df |> filter(!is.na(tmax)),
  y = ~tmax,
  type = "box",
  name = "Maximum Temperature"
) |>
  layout(
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)")
  )
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Total Precipitation

```{r}
prcp_df =
  weather_df |>
  mutate(month = lubridate::month(date)) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    total_prcp = sum(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  prcp_df,
  x = ~month,
  y = ~total_prcp,
  type = "bar"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Total precipitation (mm)")
  )
```
